canonical.standardDescription: Loggie helps people keep the digital pieces of their lives together over time—messages, files, identity, and records—with cryptographic proof when it matters.
canonical.longDescription: Loggie is a place for the digital pieces of your life that deserve to last: messages, files, identity, and records. It is designed around continuity, ownership, and verifiability, using cryptography underneath so important history can remain independently provable over time. Keep your piece of history.
